RCM Strategy.Consequence: Local loss of DC output; electrical or fire safety consequence depends on confirmed mechanism
RCM Strategy.Rationale: Separate reversible soiling and degradation from functional failure; confirm repairability and compatible replacement. AIP v864 illustrative module scenario; not verified plant inventory or OEM terms

RCM Functions & Failures.Required_Function: Generate specified DC power within the verified operating envelope while maintaining electrical and mechanical safety.
RCM Functions & Failures.Performance_Standard: Model and contract-specific output, insulation and mechanical integrity; assess under controlled conditions.
RCM Functions & Failures.Functional_Failure: Confirmed inability of an individual module to fulfil the specified function; distinguish reversible soiling and ordinary degradation.

RCM Consequence Assessment.Failure_Effect: Local DC output loss; electrical safety consequences depend on confirmed mechanism.
RCM Consequence Assessment.Business_Rule: Quantify affected module quantity, not the entire group, unless group-wide evidence exists.

RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Basis: AIP v864 illustrative module scenario; not verified plant inventory or OEM terms; screen condition and confirm electrical fault before replacement.
RCM Decision Logic.Standard_Basis: AIP demonstration RCM workflow; engineer approval required
RCM Decision Logic.Secondary_RCM_Policy: Compatible module replacement after confirmed fault
RCM Decision Logic.Fallback_Policy: Engineering review if inspection cannot detect or control the mechanism
RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Path_Summary: Detectable condition; insufficient trend history; inspect and confirm before intervention.

RCM Task Triggers.Task_Definition: Visual/thermal inspection followed by matched-condition electrical tests and connector/diode checks.
RCM Task Triggers.Trigger_Or_Threshold: Corroborated anomaly or breached verified OEM limit; no universal threshold inferred from warranty.
RCM Task Triggers.Base_Interval: 180-day illustrative inspection; engineer to approve site interval
RCM Task Triggers.Likely_Parts: Model-compatible replacement module; matched connector system if approved

RCM Climate Applicability.Climate_Stressors: Dust, humidity, salt exposure, heat cycling, hail and wind according to site evidence.
RCM Climate Applicability.RCM_Adjustment_Rule: Review inspection frequency after site-specific events; keep cleaning separate from failure history.
RCM Climate Applicability.Rule_Type: Engineering review; does not overwrite OEM limits

RCM Source Linkage.Duplication_Boundary: Source evidence only; no invented failure curve

RCM Policy Governance.Review_Cycle: After confirmed fault or material site change
RCM Policy Governance.Change_Trigger: Confirmed recurrence, completed maintenance outcome, OEM bulletin or site stress change
RCM Policy Governance.Review_Action: Approve the applicable inspection task and collect comparable completion evidence.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Thermal anomalies require matched operating conditions and electrical confirmation.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Thermal comparison, electrical test, connector and diode inspection; isolate under an approved procedure.

PV_Register_Guide.Guidance: Integrated through Asset Master and the normal Data Management workbook import.
Asset Explorer > PV Module. Select a group to view specifications and linked work, evidence, warranty and spares.
AIP v864 illustrative module scenario; not verified plant inventory or OEM terms
Asset_ID equals Group_ID. The group is maintainable; Module_Quantity is the physical population, not another count of assets.
PV_Module_Models holds electrical, mechanical and material specifications; Model_ID links population segments.
Batch_ID and Shipment_ID are traceability references; they do not define additional installed quantities.
Individual Module_ID observations only. No failures have been fabricated. Six illustrative censored observations cannot qualify a curve. Add validated unit life histories and classified events.
A thermal finding, soiling, cleaning or corrective work order is not automatically a failure.
Product and performance coverage are separate illustrative contracts. Expiry is neither predicted failure nor automatic EOL.
Quantity × module Wp gives DC nameplate already included within the site; never add it to plant AC capacity.
Use the standard Data Management upload. Keep all linked PV sheets and stable IDs; validate before applying.
Replace every demonstration specification, date, serial, batch, stock balance and contract with verified evidence.
Original SUS_Circularity_EOL records remain the source references. Reconciliation is required; removal is not proof of recycling.
AIP v867 simulated module life history; not field measurements or OEM-calibrated failure probabilities
6,000 identified simulated histories: 1,000 per existing group. Not the full 148,500-module inventory. Dates remain 2016/2020 to 2026-09-24; no fabricated 30-year observation history.
Calendar_Exposure_Hours is elapsed calendar time, not generating or measured operating hours. Operating_Hours is blank for these PV records. Analysis converts calendar exposure to years for display.
First confirmed electrical/insulation failure requiring removal. Visual defects, cleaning, low irradiance, gradual power loss and warranty expiry are not automatically counted as failures.

Survivors contribute age through cutoff. In cause-specific analysis, other failure modes are censored at their failure date. One observation per module per run; do not duplicate survivors across mode rows.

Seed 867; independent Weibull competing risks. Junction box beta 0.65, eta 25000 years; bypass diode beta 1, eta 2500; cell interconnect beta 5, eta 35; insulation beta 5, eta 40. Eta values are mathematical scenario parameters, NOT expected service lives. Original six example members are retained as survivors. Parameters are not field-calibrated.

Legacy mono: illustrative 10-year product / 25-year power warranty; 2020 mono PERC: 12-year product / 25-year power warranty. Performance floor is contractual, not measured degradation or probability of survival. Modern 30-year terms are not retroactively applied.

Short, highly censored demonstration history supports workflow testing only. Minimum counts permit fitting but do not validate long-term forecasts. Pooling sites mixes vintages; select a site for a consistent model/batch. No module-specific RUL is inferred.

The sample contains pre-opening historical removals, survivors and nine 2026 failures with physical removal unrecorded. A failure is not automatically a stock removal. Current group balances are unchanged; no replacement history is invented.
